arabic text: Haaye Mere Abbas\nJab Ridaa Sar Se Chhini, Mai Sadaa Deti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
english translation text: Alas, my Abbas\nWhen my veil was snatched from my head, I kept calling—but you did not come, Ghazi

arabic text: Aale-Imraan Kahaan, Aur Zindaan Kahaan\nYe Behen Qaid Huwi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi\nJab Ridaa Sar Se Chhini, Mai Sadaa Deti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
english translation text: Where is the family of Imran, and where is this prison?\nYour sister was made a captive—you did not come, Ghazi\nWhen my veil was snatched from my head, I kept calling—but you did not come, Ghazi

arabic text:
Hamko Paani Na Mile, Teri Khushbu Toh Rahe
Tere Baazu Na Kate, Chaahe Mashkiza Chhide
Yeh Magar Ho Na Saka, Tere Baazu Hai Judaa,
Mujhpe Hai Tashna-Labi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
Jab Ridaa Sar Se Chhini, Mai Sadaa Deti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
english translation text:
Even if we received no water, may your fragrance have remained
Even if the water-skin were pierced, may your arms not have been severed
But this could not be: your arms were cut away
And thirst remained upon me—you did not come, Ghazi
When my veil was snatched from my head, I kept calling—but you did not come, Ghazi

arabic text:
Dhup Mai Tu Thaa Shajar, Tujhse Aabaad Thaa Ghar
Hai Barehna Mera Sar, Kya Nahin Tujhko Khabar
Ay Alamdaare-Wafaa, Is Behen ko bakhuda
Tujhse Dhaaras Thi Bari, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
Jab Ridaa Sar Se Chhini, Mai Sadaa Deti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
english translation text:
In the heat you were a tree of shade; through you our home flourished
My head is uncovered—do you not know?
O standard-bearer of loyalty, by God this sister
Drew such strength from you—you did not come, Ghazi
When my veil was snatched from my head, I kept calling—but you did not come, Ghazi

arabic text:
Aagayi Shaam-e-Alam, Lutgaye Ehle-Haram
Ret Par Jalti Huwi, Hogaya Thanda Alam
Pursaa Dene Ke Liye, Mujhse Milne Ke Liye
Aagaye Baba Ali, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
Jab Ridaa Sar Se Chhini, Mai Sadaa Deti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
english translation text:
The night of grief arrived, and the household was plundered
Upon the burning sand, the standard itself grew cold
To offer condolences and to meet me
Baba Ali came—but you did not come, Ghazi
When my veil was snatched from my head, I kept calling—but you did not come, Ghazi

arabic text:
Kya Kahun Sher Mere, Beridaa Hamko Liye
Ye Musalmaa(n) Saare, Shehr dar Shehr Gaye
Khilqate Kufa Kabhi, Khilqate Shaam Kabhi
Aur Haa(n) Ham Pe Hassi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
Jab Ridaa Sar Se Chhini, Mai Sadaa Deti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
english translation text:
What can I tell you, my lion? These Muslims took us without veils
From city to city
Sometimes the people of Kufa, sometimes the people of Shaam
Laughed at us—you did not come, Ghazi
When my veil was snatched from my head, I kept calling—but you did not come, Ghazi

arabic text:
Kitni Bebas Thi Behen, Ai Shehenshaahe Wafaa
Naam Leleke Mera, Jab Ye Zaalim Ne Kahaa
Naaz Tha Jispe Tujhe, Ab Bulaaona Usse
Aur Mai Roti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
Jab Ridaa Sar Se Chhini, Mai Sadaa Deti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
english translation text:
How helpless your sister was, O King of loyalty
When the oppressor repeatedly called out my name and said
You were so proud of him—now call him
And I kept weeping—you did not come, Ghazi
When my veil was snatched from my head, I kept calling—but you did not come, Ghazi

arabic text:
Qaid Khaane Mai Qazaa, Jab Sakina Ko Mili
Deke Kurte Ka Kafan, Bacchi Dafnaayi Gayi
Us Ghari Naam Tera, Surate Naade-Ali
Dukh Mai Dohraati Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
Jab Ridaa Sar Se Chhini, Mai Sadaa Deti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
english translation text:
When Sakina met death in the prison
She was shrouded in a piece of her garment and buried
At that moment, your name, like Nad-e-Ali
I kept repeating in grief—you did not come, Ghazi
When my veil was snatched from my head, I kept calling—but you did not come, Ghazi

arabic text: Roya "Rehan" Kalam, Karke Yeh Baat Raqam\nKhun Mai Dub Gaya, Mere Ghazi Ka Alam
english translation text: "Rehan's" pen wept as it wrote these words\nThe standard of my Ghazi became submerged in blood
